title: Kaguya Bamboo Signal: Growth Observatory
subtitle: Fictional notes on bamboo growth and gentle light signals.

sections.mission: This fictional project explores imaginary bamboo growth and gentle light signals. All settings and observations are invented. It links each illustration to field notes so readers can compare the evidence and follow the sequence.
sections.challenge: How can slow fictional growth be compared when the observer visits at different times? A single illustration cannot explain the order of observations or why one interpretation was chosen. Each entry therefore records its place in the sequence, describes what changed, and keeps gaps in the imagined evidence visible.
approach: Align each painted stalk with a simple timeline and note changes in height and color.
impact: Demonstrate how patient notes make gradual change visible.

research.focus: Exploring the imagined themes of Kaguya Bamboo Signal: Growth Observatory in a fictional research record. Locations and measurements remain imaginary.
